name: ai-banisher
description: Disables all built-in AI features permanently and blocks the installation of most AI extensions
author: SAASquatch Robotics

scripts.build: pnpm run compile && pnpm run minify && pnpm run obfuscate && rm out/extension.min.js
scripts.package: pnpm run build && rm -rvf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp ../README.md dist && cp package.json dist && cp pnpm-lock.yaml dist && cp ../LICENSE dist/LICENSE.txt && mkdir -p dist/out && cp out/extension.js dist/out
